standard.summary: 定期对适配器权重增量做奇异值分解并把摘要写进训练日志，用来观察训练是否健康。
standard.effect: 默认关 = 完全不变。打开后每过一个检查间隔算一次 SVD（有少量额外开销）。
standard.whenToUse: 想诊断 LoRA 更新的秩/质量、排查训练异常时打开。
standard.avoidWhen: 不需要诊断信息时别开，白算。

standard_en.summary: Periodically computes singular values of the adapter weight deltas and writes a summary into the training log, to observe training health.
standard_en.effect: Default off = nothing changes. On, an SVD runs every check interval with a small overhead.
standard_en.whenToUse: Enable to diagnose the rank/quality of LoRA updates or investigate anomalies.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Leave off when you do not need the diagnostics.
